title: The Moon crashed Leo's daytime.
caption: Leo wanted the sky to itself, but the Moon is up in daylight on lots of days. If the Moon is feelings, they don't clock out at sunrise. Say the soft thing at noon, not only at 2 AM. Who needs to hear it today?
